note: Standing rules for the supplier / party layer. They apply to every year (unlike party_overrides.fyXX.json, which is one year only).

staff.meaning: A party is staff (imprest) if it is in Zoho vendor group 'Imprest Staff' OR carries a balance in the 'Sundry Creditors- Employees' ledger (2-06-002). A staff credit balance is shown inside Outstanding expenses (Imprest Account); a staff debit balance is an advance.

msme.meaning: Suppliers whose credit balance is shown as 'Trade payables - MSME'. Zoho does not hold the Udyam number for them (the field is empty), so the list is kept here. Source for FY26: auditors' Creditors Ageing sheet, column K = Yes and paid within the due date. Review this list every year.
